task:
Open https://www.tradingview.com/screener/ and use the stock screener to find the top 5 gainers and the top 5 losers by WEEKLY percentage change.

IMPORTANT - filter out the junk first. An unfiltered screener sorted by percentage change returns delisted shells and sub-penny stocks with moves of thousands of percent, which are corporate actions and not market movers. Before you sort, use the screener's own filter controls to exclude them: set a minimum price of at least $5, or a minimum market cap of at least $1B. Then switch to the Performance view, sort by the weekly change column (Perf % 1W) descending for the gainers and ascending for the losers, and read the rows off the actual table.

For each of the 10 stocks give me: ticker, company name, weekly % change, and last price.

Report only what you actually read off the page. If a figure is not shown, write 'not shown' rather than guessing it. Do not report any stock priced under $1 or showing a weekly move above 1000% - if those are all you can get, say so plainly and explain that the filter did not apply.
